look.why: A cool creek-water teal that sets off its rich waterproof brown fur and slate-grey duck bill.

size.measure: total length, 43–50 cm (males up to 60 cm)

habitat.text: Freshwater rivers, cool mountain streams and lakes across eastern Australia and Tasmania.

diet.text: Freshwater shrimp, insect larvae, worms and crayfish detected underwater with its electroreceptive bill.

facts.text: One of only five egg-laying mammals (monotremes) on Earth—and males carry a venomous spur on each hind ankle!
It hunts with eyes, ears and nostrils shut tight, sensing the tiny electrical pulses of prey muscles with its bill.

id.habitat: Sungai air tawar, aliran pegunungan sejuk, dan danau di Australia timur dan Tasmania.
id.diet: Udang air tawar, larva serangga, cacing, dan lobster air tawar yang dideteksi lewat sensor listrik di paruhnya.
facts: Salah satu dari hanya lima mamalia bertelur (monotremata) di Bumi—dan pejantannya punya taji berbisa di pergelangan kaki belakang!
Ia berburu dengan mata, telinga, dan hidung tertutup rapat, mendeteksi sinyal listrik otot mangsa lewat paruhnya.
